title: LinkedIn Value
description:
Why is LinkedIn still such a valuable asset to your job search? ...because it's an ACTIVE version of your professional demo reel. You can share the experience that's on your resume and also show a hiring manager how you are as a person.

Thank you so much to Ashleigh Bergh Duggan for sitting down with us and sharing your insights about the job search, where you've found success in yours and more. #jobseeker #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #linkedin #linkedintips

transcript: it's one of the things that I love the most about LinkedIn I was describing LinkedIn to a friend of mine like a living breathing demo real that you can just update all day long and the beautiful thing about it you can engage with other people folks in positions to hire can see oh this is how this person talks to strangers this is you know the Insight this person has on this topic right they can get kind of an idea about you it might not be everything it at least gives them kind of a a sense of who you are that it's really difficult to get on paper
